release_notes: Windows parity pass. Esc now also cancels while transcribing or building a prompt. The model's memory is freed after 15 minutes without dictation and reloads while you speak (Settings > Behavior). Failures show on the recording pill instead of vanishing. Cleanup no longer deletes a real thank you, bye or trailing you, keeps abbreviations like e.g. and vs., and the English vocabulary prompt is skipped for other languages. Text replacements are editable in Settings > Vocabulary. History keeps both halves of a Prompting take. Prompting fails fast on a bad key and escalates on truncated or summarized output; cloud transcription retries once. Auto-paste pastes via Cmd+V instead of typing key events.
